description: This is an Android activity class for the TV application's home screen, managing UI setup, content loading via ViewModel, and user interactions like focus and click handling across various content rails.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An Android AppCompatActivity subclass representing the TV app's home screen with top menu and content rails, managing UI setup and data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up top menu and content rails, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu buttons with focus scaling and click actions to navigate to login and main screens.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Sets up content rails based on categories, loads content asynchronously, and populates UI elements with data including images, titles, and click handlers.
